main_text.l: TAntis Abramidæ cladibus obruti Suspirant memori pectore perditum Splendorem, & veteres diuitias vocant, Lamentisque petunt æthera inanibus.
Quos risit vario lingua procax ioco Sannis ludificans Sabbatha Barbaris: Quum fracto socij fœdere fallerent, Et victor facilis sub iuga cogeret.
Sed iustus Superum sic Solymam furor Flagris exagitat vindicibus ream: Dignisque opprobrijs crimina diluens Ridendam variis plebibus obiicit.
Quicunque eximiis lucidam honoribus Laudabat prius, heu! despicit, & caput Nutat probra videns. Hinc facies pudor Auersas Solymæ purpureus tegit.
Quòd periura nefas per vetitum ruit: Quòd turpes scelerum vestibus illitas Ostentare notas gestiit, immemor, Quam tristes maneant flagitium exitus.
Nunc mersa exitio negligitur graui. Nunc aduersa premunt immiserabilem. Afflicta, ô, fer opem Cœlituum Deus: Hostilémque precor tunde superbiam.

page.notes: The Hebrew letter names (ZAIIM, HETH, TETH) are the acrostic labels printed as a line above the stanzas. "Nunc aduersa premunt immiserabilem" and "Quòd turpes scelerum vestibus illitas" follow the printed text; "IOD" is the signature at lower right. Typographic long s and s forms were normalised to plain s. Possible doubtful reading: "immiserabilem" as printed.
